text: I doubt 0.1 mg will do much anything, the least dosage I could notice anything on was 0.5 mg. LDN's actions can be partially explained by it's blockage of certain opioid receptors, which causes an increase of endorphins (rebound effect), which in turn modulates the immune system. On the common 4.5 mg dosage this blockage will last for a few hours. The lower dosage you go, the less is the duration of blockage and thus less rebound effect kicks in. I stick to 1.5 mg because anything more causes daytime sleepiness.
